run_kitti_data_prep: run create_data.py with dataset kitti to prepare KITTI dataset info files and groundtruth database
run_nuscenes_data_prep: run create_data.py with dataset nuscenes to prepare nuScenes dataset info files and 2D annotations
run_lyft_data_prep: run create_data.py with dataset lyft to prepare Lyft dataset info files and 2D annotations
run_waymo_data_prep: run create_data.py with dataset waymo to convert Waymo data to KITTI format and create info files
run_scannet_data_prep: run create_data.py with dataset scannet to prepare ScanNet indoor dataset info files
